paite: Paul, Pathian deihdan a Khrist Jesu sawltak leh i unaupa Timothi in,
heading: Chibai Bukna
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

paite: Kolossa a Khrist a misiangthoute leh unau muanhuaite kiang ah, Pathian i Pa kiang a kipan hehpihna leh khamuanna na kiang uah om hen.
english: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

paite: Nou a ding a thum gige in Pathian i Toupa Jesu Khrist Pa kiang ah kipahthu ka gen uhi,
heading: Kipahthu Genna Leh Thumna
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

paite: Khrist Jesu na gindan uh leh misiangthou tengteng tung a itna na neihdan uh ka zak tak ziak un.
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

paite: Huai bel nou a ding a lametna van a koihkholh a a-om ziak ahi. Huai lametna tanchin mah tuma in, tanchinhoih thutak na zata uhi.
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

paite: Huai tanchinhoih tuh khovel tengteng ah gah a akhan zel mah bang in na kiang uh ahong tung a, Pathian hehpihna na ngaihkhiak ua na zak ni ua kipan in, noumau ah leng gah in akhang zel hi.
english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

paite: Huchibang in Epaphras i sikha hihpih ngaihtak lak a na zil bang un, amah kou sik in Khrist nasempa muanhuai ahi.
english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

paite: Ama'n Kha a na itna uh ahon hilh hi.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

paite: Huaiziak in ka zak ni ua kipan kou leng noute a ding in thum leh nget ka tawp kei uhi; huchi a khalam pilna leh theihna tengteng a adeihlam theihna a hihdim a na hong omtheihna ding un.
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

paite: Huan nasep hoih chiteng a gah a, Pathian theihna a khang a, ama kipah lam a Toupa a dia kilawm a na hintheihna ding un.
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

paite: Kipahna toh kithuah thuakhatna leh kuhkalna nei ding in, ahatna thupi bang zel a hihhat in hong om un.
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

paite: Vak a misiangthoute gouluahpih dia hon chingsak Pa kiang a kipahthu gen in.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

paite: Ama'n mial thuneihna lak a kipan hon suaktasak in, a Tapa ittak gam ah hon kaisakta hi.
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

paite: Amah ah i tatkhiakna leh khelhnate ngaihdamna i mu uhi.
english: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

paite: Amah muh theih louh Pathian batpih, thilsiam tengteng a piang masapen ahi.
heading: Khrist Tungnunna
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

paite: Amah ah bangkim siam ahi a, van a omte leh lei a omte, muhtheihte leh muh theihlouhte, laltutphahte, thuneihnate, vaihawmnate leh thilhihtheihnate hitaleh bangkim ama siam ahi, amah a ding mah a siam ahi.
english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

paite: Huan amah zaw bang teng om ma in leng a-om hi, amah ah bang teng adingkhawm chiat uhi.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

paite: Amah tuh pumpi, saptuam lutang ahi a; bangkim a tungnungpen ahong hihtheihna ding in abulpi, misi lak a kipan piang masapen ahi.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

paite: Amah ah Pathian taangchinna tengteng a om Pa deihlamtak ahi,
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

paite: Ama kros sisan a lemna abawl in amah ah bangkim amah toh akilemsak a; amah ngei ah lei a thil omte leh van a thil omte leng amah toh akilemsakta hi.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

paite: Huan nou tuma lam in na lungsim uah amelma na hi ua, na thilhih gilou ua amah a kipan a khen a om na hi uhi, himahleh tu in ama'n amah toh hon kilemsakta a;
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

paite: asihna in apumpi ah amah toh noute ahon kilemsakta hi, ama a siangthou, gensiatbei leh mohsak theih louh a ahon dinsak theihna ding in,
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

paite: kingakna nei a kiptak a om a, tanchinhoih na zak ua lametna a kipan a suanmang a om lou a, ginna a na om gige peuhmah uleh; huai tanchinhoih van nuai a thilsiam tengteng lak a tangkoupih ahi a; kei Paul leng huai nna sem ding a bawl ka hi.
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

paite: Nou ziak a tu a ka gimthuaknate ah ka kipak hi; huan apumpi ziak a Khrist in agimthuaknate ban zom zel ka hi; huai tuh Saptuam ahi.
heading: Paul Sepgimna
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

paite: Nou a ding a Pathian nasepna kei kiang a piak a om bang zel in huai saptuam nasempa ka hong hita; Pathian thu bukimtak a theisak ding in.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

paite: Huai Pathian thu tuh tangtawn leh akhang-akhang a kipan a thuguk kisel ahi; tu in bel misiangthoute kiang ah latsak in a-omta hi.
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

paite: Amau kiang ah, Zentelte lak a huai thuguk thupina hauhsakna atamdan Pathian in theihsak a-ut him ahi; huai thuguk tuh Khrist noumau a om, thupina lametna pen ahi.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

paite: Michih Khrist a hoihkim a ka piaktheihna ding un michih hilh in, pilna chiteng a zilsak in, atanchin ka gen zel uhi.
english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

paite: Huchibang ding in nakpitak a keimah a asepsak thahatna tengteng zang in theihtawp in ka sem zel hi.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
